description: A light wooden tabletop is in front of you with a small white AirPods charging case. The right hand brings the case in from the right and sets it near the center, then both hands come together to flip the lid open; the right hand lifts out one earbud and places it on the table to the right, then reaches back to remove the second earbud and sets it next to the first while the left hand steadies the open case, and finally the left hand closes the lid.
